resources.description: An agent skill that farms DustSwap points on Base mainnet unattended: daily on-chain check-in plus swap-volume quests that actually get credited. 414 lines, language-agnostic. Exact endpoints and payloads, the attribution config a swap must carry or it earns nothing, headless login, official progress reading, spend-capped pacing, pinned addresses, and seven costly pitfalls. Proven with real funds. Under $1. Points have no announced conversion rate — a recipe, not a yield promise.
